data.one_liner: A widget that detects long presses and triggers callbacks after a hold timeout.
data.what_it_does: HoldDetector extends GestureDetector to call a callback after a specified hold duration. HoldTimeoutDetector triggers callbacks when a hold reaches a timeout, with optional cancel and initiation callbacks.
use_when: You need a button that reacts to long presses with a custom timeout.
You want haptic feedback on each hold tick.
You need to perform an action only after the user holds for a set duration.
You want to cancel the action if the user releases early.
avoid_when: You only need a simple tap or long press without custom timeout logic.
You are building a complex gesture system that requires low-level gesture recognizers.
You need to support gestures on platforms that don't support haptic feedback.
strengths: Supports custom hold timeout and haptic feedback.
Provides both immediate hold and timeout-based callbacks.
weaknesses: Limited to hold gestures; no other gesture types.
No built-in visual feedback for the hold state.
Requires manual handling of onPressed conflicts.
No support for platform-specific gesture nuances.
data.minimal_example:
HoldDetector(
  onHold: _incrementCounter,
  holdTimeout: Duration(milliseconds: 200),
  enableHapticFeedback: true,
  child: ElevatedButton(
    onPressed: _incrementCounter,
    child: Text("onHold"),
  ),
)
